chapter_title: 第六章 奇门遁甲应用概述
important_method_guard: Source author calls the host/guest relationship principles four but enumerates five; preserve all five.
The 1995 rocket launch example has known timing and some chart conditions and outcome but NO complete nine-palace chart; do not use it as complete independent test.
The historical assertions about damage are the book author's narrative, not externally verified real-world facts.
Timing rule choice requires conditions; calendar event date cannot be invented.
Do not treat 8640/1080=8 as evidence of 8 repeated complete charts; 8640 in prior chapter denotes 8 outer palaces per 1080 bureau-hour indices.
